summary: This bill ensures continuous funding for the SNAP and WIC programs, even during government shutdowns or funding delays, by automatically appropriating necessary funds and requiring their immediate release and uninterrupted distribution to eligible individuals.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates the appropriation of funds for SNAP and WIC during periods without full-year appropriations, ensuring continuous funding for these programs. This effectively increases the commitment to government spending on these programs by making their funding automatic even during budget impasses.

The core purpose of this bill is to ensure the uninterrupted provision of benefits for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) and the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC), which are key components of the social safety net. It prevents funding delays and enrollment freezes, thereby expanding and securing access to these welfare programs.

The bill creates an automatic, open-ended appropriation of 'such sums as are necessary' for SNAP and WIC during any lapse in regular appropriations and mandates immediate obligation and disbursement of funds. This directly prioritizes continued spending on these programs over any potential deficit-reduction measures or normal appropriations controls, making the legislation centrally about accepting larger deficits to maintain these priorities.
